notes.title: UPDATE 0.98 - Poggers Gets Buffed, The Assassin Gets Nerfed + More!

notes.title: UPDATE 0.97 - Two Brand New Ships, The Assassin Stealth Enemy & A Healing Angel!
notes.content:
Hello all, 

In this big update to Zaxterion: Space Frenzy!, I've addressed several bugs that mostly dealt with the most newly added baby spider hordes that I added last summer to the game.  It's been several weeks making this update, so I'm honestly void of exactly what bugs I fixed now, but I assure you that those baby spiders are still a massive pain to deal with!  The best bet is to not let that spider lay too many eggs in his web without taking care of them!

The main part of this patch adds two brand new ships to the game that you can earn and play forever once you earn and purchase them!  ..Remember that the game saves all of your earned Zaxterion in the game and all of your purchased ships you use that Zaxterion to buy!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/ff6f2ec1a72a09b90c991788959e7614564ffd6b.jpg[/img]
"Crazy Kyle!" is the first "ship" you can purchase and yes, you see that correct if you think you just see a dude in standard clothing and a propeller attached to his head!  ..Notice in the ship stats that he also has a slow shooting speed and ZERO armor!  ..This guy is just for "fun" and/or for bragging rights if you happen to find this game just "too easy"!

---------------

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/02983bb813111fe74207e4b36cbd27da01d32fd4.jpg[/img]
"The Swagger" is the second new ship that I've added to the game in this update, and you might have noticed that this ship has NO standard shooting!  This ship is all about using your path to double up on your trail to set it ablaze which can not only harm all asteroids and enemies in the game, but also damage YOU if you run into it!  Be careful with it, learn how to use it, and I'm sure you'll fall in love with the new "Swagger" ship with it's unique powers!


These two ships now make to the total number of ships 12, and should help add to the replay value of a game I already feel has extremely high replay-ability!  I hope you enjoy them!

---------------

The Assassin: New Stealth Enemy
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/a01c82cb903485dc0de1d1b4d039837952133b85.jpg[/img]
The Assassin is a brand new enemy that will make loops and shoot out deadly missiles in many directions as it loops!  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/1de8542fb8e0b66ce90071dbb53ff368e320413a.jpg[/img]
The Assassin will also stealth itself whenever it detects that you've fired at it!  Discovering exactly how to take on this stealthy and crafty new foe is all up to you!

---------------

The Healing Angel Power-Up:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/42e4d6f03750893796c3ad679231962891a63c61.jpg[/img]
The Healing Angel is a brand new power-up that can be found on the Mother-ship on occasion whenever it visits you at the cost of some of your gold.. or sometimes found in loot chests as well!  It only lasts for a brief period of time, but during that time, it will follow you around and heal you much like a Cleric in a classic MMORPG!


As with most indie games, this new content will need to be tested and played by many players over time and there will likely be some in-balances and bugs found.  Please help me by posting any problems you find either in the comments below or in the forums for this game to help me put out hot fixes and updates to make your experience better!



Thank you for reading!

Have Fun!!


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.96 - Spider Hordes! - The Death Spider Now Lays Eggs, Oh My!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/9a08c7c306796ae1e43b8b222360301230236617.jpg[/img]

Yes, you read it right!  As if Zaxterion: Space Frenzy! didn't have enough threats to worry about, now you'll need to be wary of the spider lurking in his corner web.  He's always been a threat if you got too close, but no longer can you just stay on the opposite side of the screen as if you do, he will slowly form an army of eggs in his web that he'll protect with protective webbing until eventually they will be unleashed!  Once this happens, you'll be relentlessly swarmed and mercilessly attacked by the spider demons and have to fight for your life!

To prevent this insane and deadly chaos from occurring, you'll need to attack the Death Spider before he has a chance to form and protect the eggs that can quickly accumulate and spell your doom!

Here's a look at the new content:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eakwe6F_lvI

..This is exciting new content and has been added in this update and is completely free!

-----------------------

Other changes made in this update:

* Gold nuggets now wrap around just like asteroids and all enemies and your own ship.  Before this update, gold nuggets would disappear forever if they went off the screen.  This means more gold is now available for you.. and that dreaded goblin too!

* The prices have increased for most of the power-ups that can be purchased from the mother ship that visits at the top of the screen.  This was to ensure that some of the strongest power-ups in the game cost more than more common power-ups.  (Note: health costs have NOT increased in price)

* The mother ship that visits you at the top of the screen and the brother ship that visits and the bottom of the screen now could visit you from either side.  Before this update, the mother ship only came in from the left and the brother ship only came in on the right side of the screen.  Now, both of these ships could visit you from either direction.

* The Poggers DLC ship hasn't been changed mechanically at all, but shooting a skull no longer shows a "Pow!  /Blam! / Zonk!" type of cartoon word.  That kinda of old Batman TV show type of word now only shows up when you use your power bounce to smack a skull for damage rather than simply shooting it.  ..I think that this fits my vision of what the Poggers ship and my old 2019 Poggers Steam game much better!

* Some details of the mother ship have been enhanced to make it more visually appealing.

-----------------------

Enjoy fighting the hordes of eight legged freaks!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS .. (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.94 - The Goblin Gets Massive Buffs & THE EYE Is Here!
notes.content:
Update 0.94 brings on intense new battles for your gold dropped from asteroids and chests with the new and improved goblin!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/ad79f5a317cc034fb4f05770e6aa58ae18431a34.jpg[/img]

The goblin has new improved skin that gives him about 20x the natural armor as before!  ..It will take either a hell of a lot of regular shots or the help of power-ups to take him out now!  It's up to you to learn what the most effective methods of giving him the most pain will be!

The goblin will now keep cycling back across your screen stealing your gold until you take him out!

The goblin will now stop and use your stolen gold to cast an assortment of spells to try and destroy you and end your game!  ..and of course he has even more evil and sinister laughs then ever before!

One of these new spells the goblin can cast is spawning the Eye, an enemy that has been lurking in development hell since this game launched!  The eye will give you an all new challenge as it takes control or nearby asteroids and hurls them at your ship at high speeds!  

- You now get a satisfying "Intercepted" on screen display whenever you intercept a gold chunk that the goblin is pulling in to himself!

- Many new sound effects and new music has been added to the game for this update!

- The goblin now shows multiple stages of damage to help you get a sense of how much you've damaged him.


I'm sure that this update will present undiscovered glitches and bugs as well as some balance issues that will need to be ironed out.  As with all my updates and all my games, I'll be playing and watching this closely in the coming days and weeks and updates will come as needed.

I hope that you enjoy the new challenges that this update and the new & improved goblin will bring!


Sincerely, 

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.93 - Lots of Changes and Fixes + 38 New Steam Achievements!
notes.content:
It's been a few months since I've made an update to Zaxterion: Space Frenzy, but I think there is some good stuff here!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/baadd77cf8c7668eeaa3418997a7580728e7b214.png[/img]

* 38 New Steam Achievements:  The Valorox ship now has many all new achievements to match all of the existing achievements for the Reliant default ship, the Poggers DLC ship, and the Halycon ship.  Many more Steam achievements are in the works, but I"ll need Steam to approve my recent request to allow me to add more than the 100 Steam achievement limits per game.

* Added a new message that will display how much longer it will be until the Mothership will visit you again with its health restoration and power-up services that it offers.  The message will display towards the top of the screen when the Mothership starts to leave and also when the Big Brother ship departs.

* The Mothership, starting with this update will now take an additional 2 seconds to re-visit you every time it departs.  This change was made to help add a slowly increased challenge to players as they master the game.

* The message that appears when the Goblin leaves the screen will now tell you both how much gold he stole from you and also how much total gold he holds.  In an upcoming update, the Goblin will start being able to spend your stolen gold to spawn new enemies and cast spells to try and thwart you!

* A bug was fixed that would sometimes cause two of the same music track to play simultaneously which definitely sounded odd when it happened.

* A bug was fixed that would sometimes cause a gold chunk that you collected to be worth zero gold.

* A bug was fixed that would cause the spider to re-spawn much sooner than intended after you killed him.

* An issue was resolved where you could try to buy health via the Mothership when you were already over 100 health, and both your gold would be taken and your health would be reduced to 100.  This has been changed to simply not allow you to purchase health if you have 100 or more health when you move up through the Mothership 'buy health' side.

* The Fusion ship has been changed back to its original "super sonic" speeds that it had last fall.  A previous update had reduced its speed due to a single complaint but that change made the Fusion so it simply felt too much like all the other ships.  The Fusion was intended to make you feel raw power and speed and to have "fun" with, however it is intended for experienced gamers.

* The spiders web that captured your ship has been changed to have a new improved look.

* A bug was fixed that would allow you to rez at full health and go below zero in Zaxterion.  This Zaxterion "debt" was never intended and has been fixed.  If you try to buy a full health rez that you cannot afford now, the game will simply buzz at you to let you know that you do not have enough Zaxterion to pay for the full health resurrection. 


I think that is about all for this update.  More updates are expected soon.. so keep an eye out if you are a fan of this game!  =)


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.91 - Asteroids Look Better Than Ever, Multiple Game Changes!
notes.content:
Hello gamers, 

In this update, I've been working to balance the game, the ships, and making the game look better.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/c2e2c340960f8242ed58e06dbafa97862138aedd.jpg[/img]

Before this update, the large asteroids were stretched by the game code to about 3x the size I originally drew them at.  This was never intended to be left this way forever as I was just trying to focus on getting the game up and working during development.  Now, I've finally re-drawn all of the large asteroids to make them look MUCH better and cleaner in this current build.  I've also shaded both the large and small asteroids to give each one it's own individual color shade.

There are still three options for what kind of look you prefer for the asteroids.  These are found in the OPTIONS before you start a game, and I highly recommend you try them all out to see the differences in the game and which look you like the best!

- Several of the ships have had their special powers and/or speeds and armor levels changed to try and balance them better.  This will continue to be an ongoing process as development on this continues over time.

- Health leaf spawns from destroyed asteroids have been significantly reduced.  Due to old testing code I accidentally left in the game, the drop rate was about 1 health leaf out of every 22 asteroids destroyed.  This was never intended to be left this way and the now deleted 'testing' code means the overall spawn rate of health leaves dropping from asteroids at about 1 health leaf in every 75 asteroids destroyed.  This was the original intended drop rate for health leaves on asteroids and will likely make a pretty big difference in the overall challenge of this game.  Health leaves do drop much more frequently by killed enemies than by destroying asteroids, and this is exactly as it was intended.

- Skulls and Space Birds can now destroy large asteroids with their shots.  This means that if a spider is on an asteroid and you are choosing to try and avoid the spider by avoiding shooting that asteroid, you may now be in for an unwelcome surprise visitor!

- The spider crawling on large asteroids has been completely redone to look better than ever!

- Many other balance changes and small bugs that have been found while playing have been made to the game in the past couple of weeks, and if I remember them and anything major that I forgot to mention here, I will edit this update.

For now, just know that Zaxterion: Space Frenzy! is continuing to evolve and become and better game with each new update.  There are still TONS of updates and new content I have planned to add that is only partially completed and/or isn't fully tested yet.  Look for these changes in updates in the near future and until them, I hope you are enjoying my game!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS .. (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.89 - More Ammo, More Danger, And Much More Coming Soon!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I hope that you are all doing well and not stressing or over spending too much during the hectic Christmas season this year.

This update brings a lot of changes that should increase the overall enjoyment you'll get when playing Zaxterion: Space Frenzy!  ..Let's get started with the list of additions and changes as usual:

-----------------------

- The amount of ammo sticks given to you by the game has been increased by about 225% which means that finding additional ammo when you run out or run low should be easier than ever before!

- Because of the greatly increased ammo, the amount of gold and green health leaves dropped by asteroids has been reduced to help keep a healthy balance in the game.

- A new "High Scores" button has been added to the screen so you can now take a look at the current high scores before playing a game.

- You can simply left click your mouse while moving the cursor over "Press R to re-start" at the high scores screen to return to the Start screen.

- The skulls have been changed so they will be better prepared for changes coming real soon where the goblin will be able to use the gold he steals from you to spawn more skulls, heal himself, cast walls of deadly fire on the screen, and so much more!  You'll now never see more than one skull at a time with an explanation point over it meaning that it is looking to merge with another skull.  The skull merging AI has been changed to always seek out the closest skull to it for faster merging and faster powering up!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/927388c7782e69b531c83b7ae30003b8315e166b.jpg[/img]

- The skull shots will now explode against all asteroids and blow off small specks of rock and dust when they impact an asteroid.

- If a skull shot hits a smaller sized asteroid, that asteroid now has a good chance of changing to the direction of the skull shot that impacted it.  When this happens, it will also increase in speed for a short time.

- Gold chest and Rhodium chest costs have now been re-worked so that they are more in-line with a cost associated with the length of time you've been playing that single game.  This does NOT mean that you'll always have enough good or rhodium to afford opening it, just that overall, the costs should be lower and more realistic than before.

- Ricocheting off of the bad bird has been re-worked to prevent undesirable situations where you might have been caught under it's wings bouncing and taking damage many times in a row.

- Two new sound effects have been added for the spiders attacks where the spider either shoots a web ball at you that traps you in a web when it hits you and its damage attack which damages your ship if it hits you.

-----------------------

I think that's about it for this update, but HUGE updates are coming soon with new enemies and a complete overhaul to the Poggers ship as well!

See you soon.  Have FUN and stay safe out there!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.88 - Rock Scores, Rock Glow Options, and More!
notes.content:
In version 0.88, I've added the following things and changes to the game:

- Scores for destroying asteroids have been slightly increased, but the increase in points will magnify more and more over time as the asteroids start moving faster

- Scores for destroying all asteroids are now displayed in white text that fades out.  Regardless of how you destroy the asteroids, you'll still see how many points you got for destroying them

- Added an option in the game settings to turn on an orange glow around the border of asteroids. This can be turned on for preference or if you simply have bad eyes and need more clarity of the asteroids

- Fixed an issue that could cause the game to minimize to your task bar when you use multiple monitors and are in full screen mode if you moved the mouse off the game window and clicked a mouse button

- Fixed an issue that could cause the game to lag for about a second if the Big Brother ship and the Mother ship were on the screen at the same time

- Fixed an issue that affected some Windows 11 users to not see the background stars properly

- Fixed an issue with the Toxicanth ship that caused the toxic trail to not properly heal you if a skull was near by or shooting at you


That's about it for this update!  

---

I have LOTS of ideas that will be added in the coming days to this game including:

* A brand new ship that can leap at asteroids and enemies at fast speeds to destroy or damage them!

* New enemies including the Eye that will take hold of asteroids magically and hurl them at you and a devastating new enemy that can fire at machine gun speeds at you!

* A Healing Angel that will help heal you  as you play but must be protected by you as well!

* Many more Steam achievements that will end up putting the total achievements well over 200!


Game on gamers!

Talk to you soon!

Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS  ...  (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.86 - Starting Ship Now Offers TOTAL CONTROL Over Ship Speed!
notes.content:
THE STARTING RELIANT SHIP NOW MOVES SLOWER BUT GIVES YOU TOTAL SPEED CONTROL:
In an effort to make "Zaxterion: Space Frenzy!" more new player friendly, I've basically cut the Reliant Ships (the starting ship) speed in half.  I've also added the ability for the Reliant ship to stop its speed anywhere from its slowest speed to its fastest available speed while playing.

Every other ship will still have the natural tendency towards moving towards its base speed (in the middle of the speed bar on the bottom center UI) if you aren't giving it gas or slowing it down with the W and S keys respectively. 

HELP WINDOW NOW MORE EASILY ACCESSIBLE:
Before you start any game, you'll now see a prompt in the upper left hand corner offering the game help window by simply hitting the "H" key.  Once you bring up that window, the prompt will change to allow you to press the SPACE bar to remove the game help window.

TURNING SPEED: 
Changes for ALL ships have now been simplified.  Every ships turning speed is simply based on it's current speed, so the faster any ship is moving forward, the greater its turning speed will be.  This will help reward players for purchasing and learning to maneuver faster ships in this game.  

GAME UPDATES MAY STILL OCCUR AT ANY TIME:
As always, these changes may be altered as necessary with future updates to help create a diverse selection of ships but also reward players with more power for learning to master control of faster ships.

IMPORTANT NOTE:  
Once this game reaches version 1.0, the high scores will be deleted so that every player is on a fresh playing field at that point.


Be sure and let me know your thoughts in the comments below!

Thanks for playing and/or reading!


ZaxtorGameS  ... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.85 - General Fixes & Balancing
notes.content:
In this update, several small fixes and balances have been made to Zaxterion: Space Frenzy!

- Fixed an issue that could cause you to spend the gold required to open a loot chest that was fading out, but the chest wouldn't deliver the loot before it faded out.

- Fixed an issue that could cause the Transmulgifier to be offered by the Big Brother ship after you already own it.

- Fixed an issue that could cause no Zaxterion gems to be offered on rare occasion after purchasing them with rhodium from the Big Brother ship.

- Nerfed the firing speed of the Valorox ship from 5 shots per second to 3.75 shots per second.

- Nerfed the armor strength of the "Protect Me Daddy!" shielding available from the Big Brother ship by about 30%.  These shields made a ship just take too little damage once 5 or 6 shields were collected.

- Fixed an issue that could cause the transmulgifier icon to show on the Big Daddy offer display even after the transmulgifier had been purchased and another offer was displayed.

- Increased the size and brightness of every ships shots to make them more visible against the trail each shot leaves as it travels.

- Fixed an issue that could cause the Halcyon ship to flash when damage was taken rather than displaying the correct damaged state.


That's it for this update.  Look for more Steam achievements and the new "Eye" enemy to come to Zaxterion in the coming weeks.


ZaxtorGameS  ..(Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.82 - Full Controller Support And Rebindable Keyboard Keys Added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/5702358b50dfb8c699a342a9aaea03cfbae2cf79.png[/img]

This update added a new "options" screen where you can now see and adjust your game volume, your controller dead zone setting, and even rebind the WASD keys and the default space bar for placing dynamite to whatever keys you desire!  (The keys you change to must be either a number or an alphabet character.  Whenever you change your key binds to, the game automatically immediately saves them so you'll never have to change them again, unless you want to change them again!  There is also a "default settings" button for the key binds to just set them back to WASD and the Space Bar if you ever want to.

The also now constantly detects if you're using a keyboard and mouse to play or if you're using a gamepad controller.  If you're using a controller, all functions before and after a game have the controller buttons associated with them clearly defined and easy to see.

This update also includes four new interesting Steam achievements that reward you for scratching death, looking it in the eye with just a single hitpoint, and then rebounding completely up to 100 or more health!

More changes are coming including lots more Steam achievements and all new enemies such as the eye and the ice man.

Thanks for reading and for playing my game if you're already purchased it and are playing my game!


Sincerely,

ZaxtorGameS  ..... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: UPDATE 0.81 - 36 New Steam Achievements Plus More Small Additions and Fixes
notes.content:
In this update, just two days after I launched this game, I've created and added 36 new Steam achievements, bringing the total achievements to 58.

The starter ship (The Reliant), The soon-coming Golden Poggers DLC ship, and the Halcyon ship all have 12 new achievements that are obtained by both surviving and scoring in your games.  All of the other seven ships will soon get the same 12 Steam achievements each, but 120 Steam achievements all at once would have been a big task.  This update at least gets you started on the starter ship and the next two ships that make sense as far as game progression goes.


Here's some other things added to the game since launch in this update:

-----------------------------------

* Added a new healing effect and sound when you move upwards through your mothership to buy a heal

* Added a red exclamation point that pops up over you when you get webbed by the spider

* Added a new sound effect when a spider shoots you with a web attack projectile 

*  Added new shine effects to show power-ups that drop from opening a golden chest

* Added new shine effects to show a ship you have not yet purchased before you start a game

* Added new effects to help show you when you purchase a power-up time upgrade, a "Ammo Kablamo" upgrade, or a "Hurt Me Less Daddy" upgrade from the Big Brother ship

* Changed the golden chest spawn points to the upper left or upper right sides of the screen to help avoid power-up loot items from being confused with mother-ship offerings

* Added Triple uploads at different times over a few seconds when uploading your score to Steam for posting your high scores.  This should ensure that your high score will always post to Steam assuming that Steam is not down at that moment and that you have good working internet

-----------------------------------

I think that's about all for this update.  As with all of my games after launch, this game will continue to get many more updates that both make the game a better experience and add more depth and content as the weeks and months go on.


Enjoy your day and thanks for reading!


ZaxtorGameS  .... (Solo Indie Game Developer)

notes.title: Zaxterion: Space Frenzy! .. Has Launched! - "The Eye" Is Coming Soon!!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I am proud to announce that my latest arcade action retro game has now launched.  This is a title I am very proud of and one that I started work on back in April of 2021.  It got put on the back burner sometime in the early summer of that same year and I started working on it again around May of this year.  I've put a lot of blood, sweat, and tears into this game over this last several months, but I believe the result has been well worth it!

I want everyone to know that just as with all my Steam games, this one is far from being "complete" in my view, but after a couple of delays, I knew it was time to just launch it already.  There are lots of ideas I still have to make the game deeper and add even more value to this already addicting and fun game!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42429636/6965761899ba756b2c609ea4da99e7f3f1a39f02.png[/img]

One of those ideas is coming to life and should be added soon with a new foe to face, and I simply call it "The Eye".   The eyes will be a very formidable foe indeed, especially when you have many eyes on you at once with all the chaos that is already going on!  I'll save all the details of this new creature for you to experience first hand in the game because I don't want to spoil your fun, but trust me you'll want to keep an "eye" out on this one!


I decided to not launch this game as version 1.0 because in my mind, it still has so much I think I can add to enrich it even more.  Do note that this game is way more complete right now than most 'early access' titles here on Steam, but I just want this game to be the best that it can be.

I've been so hard at work the last month in particular that lots of stuff like Achievements and Controller Support were just added just hours before I launched this game!  So with that, please understand that many more Steam achievements will be added over the coming weeks, including some really interesting ones like an achievement for rebounding from 1 hp to 100 hp.
